title: Scarification
summary: SCARIFICA'TION, noun [Latin scarificatio. See Scarify.] In surgery, the operation of making several incisions in the skin with a lancet or other cutting instrument, particularly the cupping instrument

inlines.v: SCARIFICA'TION, noun [Latin scarificatio. See Scarify.] In surgery, the operation of making several incisions in the skin with a lancet or other cutting instrument, particularly the cupping instrument.
